security.title: Frontend security
security.body: JWT/OAuth2 auth and RBAC across patient, admin and document-upload flows, with XSS/CSRF-aware handling and SonarQube-enforced quality gates on every merge.

testing.title: Testing & quality
testing.body: Jest and React Testing Library on the paths that matter most — 90% statement coverage on PVR INOX's booking & payment flow, enforced through SonarQube quality gates before merge.

ai.title: AI-assisted, engineer-reviewed
ai.body: GitHub Copilot, Cursor and Claude (via MCP connectors) for prompt engineering, test scaffolding, code review and Figma-to-code conversion — cut delivery time by about 30% at UV Technologies, with every AI-generated change reviewed for bugs and security issues before merge.
